ProgramUnit.Name: DUPLICATE_REC_EXISTS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION DUPLICATE_REC_EXISTS RETURN BOOLEAN IS
 v_count number(2) := 0;
BEGIN
 --put check for finding group
 IF nvl(:in_rec_g,'N') = 'Y' and :system.record_status = 'INSERT' THEN
 return FALSE;
 END IF;
 
 --compare the gobal variables populated in pre-record trigger
if :GLOBAL.attrib_added_group = :attribute_matrix.attrib_added_group 
 and :GLOBAL.attrib_added_code = :attribute_matrix.attrib_added_code
 -- and :GLOBAL.attrib_deleted_group = NVL(:attribute_matrix.attrib_deleted_group,'xxxxxx')
 and :GLOBAL.attrib_deleted_code = NVL(:attribute_matrix.attrib_deleted_code,'xxxxxx')
 --and :GLOBAL.associated_attrib_group = NVL(:attribute_matrix.associated_attrib_group,'xxxxxx')
 and :GLOBAL.associated_attrib_code = NVL(:attribute_matrix.associated_attrib_code,'xxxxxx') then --nothing has changed - 
 return False; 
else --do the duplicate check 
 Select count(*)
 into v_count
 from attribute_matrix
 where attrib_added_group = :attribute_matrix.attrib_added_group
 and attrib_added_code = :attribute_matrix.attrib_added_code
 ---and nvl(attrib_deleted_group,'xxxxxx') = nvl(:attribute_matrix.attrib_deleted_group,'xxxxxx')
 and nvl(attrib_deleted_code,'xxxxxx') = nvl(:attribute_matrix.attrib_deleted_code,'xxxxxx')
 --and nvl(associated_attrib_group,'xxxxxx') = nvl(:attribute_matrix.associated_attrib_group,'xxxxxx')
 and nvl(associated_attrib_code,'xxxxxx') = nvl(:attribute_matrix.associated_attrib_code,'xxxxxx'); 
end if; 
 If v_count = 0 then
 return FALSE;
 else
 return TRUE;
 End if; 
END;
